race.comment: SIMPLY BETTER (6) consistent mare who overcame the outside gate with a fast-finishing victory over 1000m at Quirindi second-up. Well drawn for this and gets her chance to tick off the 1200m box. Go close. NOT MEE (13) got off the mark at her third race start when she relished the firmer track to score a dominant win over 1200m at Tamworth. Has further upside and looks to have solid top-three claims. MASTER GEE (2) much better effort last time out when he stalked the speed for a narrow second over 1200m at Tamworth. Claim helps again and sure to be thereabouts. CELESTIAL DEAL (9) won on debut at Scone two back, then failed to get through the heavy (9) going with a tiring sixth over 1200m at Gosford. This looks much easier but she must overcome the wide gate.
